name: Microbial EOR
principle: Microbes or their nutrients are injected to lower interfacial tension, reduce viscosity, plug thief zones or generate gas. A 1995 survey of 322 US projects found 81% raised production; the Alton field (Australia) reported a 40% increase in 12 months; cost is cited below $10 per incremental barrel.

process_steps.name: Shut in to let microbes act

suppliers.name: Research groups and small service companies

source.note: Wikipedia, Microbial enhanced oil recovery, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.metric: incremental oil from MEOR field treatments (Vizcacheras, Argentina; Carter sandstone, Alabama US; China blocks)
performance.basis: Vizcacheras field (Papagayos reservoir, Argentina): 37,000 bbl additional oil Aug 2000-Aug 2003; Carter sandstone field (Alabama, US, nutrient injection): 69,000 bbl extra oil (project reported around yearend 1996); China blocks reported in tonnes (Dagang Guan 69 about 8,700 t by Jul 2004; Daqing Chaoyanggou 9,175 t). Oil & Gas Journal review of 10 field cases, 221 wells

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, MEOR applications - field cases illustrate effectiveness, 24 Aug 2009 (read 2026-10-28)

limitations: Mostly sandstone; only Norne and Bokor offshore
